## 🐛 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## 🎯 Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## 📸 Screenshots / Logs
If applicable, add screenshots, browser console logs, or FastAPI terminal tracebacks to help explain your problem.

## 🖥️ Environment Information
- **OS**: [e.g. Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04, macOS Sonoma]
- **Browser** (if Frontend): [e.g. Chrome 124, Edge, Firefox]
- **Node.js Version**: [e.g. v20.x]
- **Python Version**: [e.g. 3.11.x]
- **Hardware Acceleration / WebGL**: [Enabled / Disabled]

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g., raster tile size, GeoTIFF sensor type, specific AOI coordinates).
